content.value_statement: Incomplete catalog data and product mismatches can cause disapprovals and weak Shopping performance. This skill audits feeds and proposes specific, source-based corrections.
actual_capabilities: Triages product disapprovals by item, likely cause, and proposed correction.
Audits required and recommended catalog attributes for missing values.
Rewrites titles and descriptions using vertical-specific, front-loaded patterns.
Flags GTIN, price, availability, claim, and landing-page mismatches.
Proposes listing groups and asset groups based on real feed fields.
limitations: Requires a feed export, diagnostics report, or sufficient catalog fields from the user.
Does not invent identifiers, prices, inventory, categories, or product specifications.
Does not submit feed changes or resolve platform appeals automatically.
Does not replace current platform policy review or account-level performance auditing.

use_cases.title: Repair Merchant Center Disapprovals
use_cases.description: Map each rejected product to a likely cause, required evidence, and proposed feed correction.

use_cases.title: Improve Catalog Titles
use_cases.description: Rewrite product titles with high-intent attributes while preserving accurate variants and product details.

use_cases.title: Plan Feed-Based Campaign Groups
use_cases.description: Organize approved products into listing groups or asset groups using existing catalog fields.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Product
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this product row for missing required attributes and likely disapproval causes. Explain each correction without inventing data: [product row].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single catalog item

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Feed Export
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Shopping feed export: [feed]. List missing fields, identifier problems, price or availability mismatches, and recommended source-based fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite Titles by Vertical
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite these titles for [vertical] using accurate front-loaded attributes. Preserve each real brand, model, specification, and variant. Flag missing source data.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Remediation and Grouping Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this feed and diagnostics report: [inputs]. Prioritize disapprovals, propose corrected attributes, flag policy risks, and design listing groups for [campaign goal].
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced feed remediation and campaign planning

output_examples.input: A shoe item has no GTIN, says in stock, and links to a sold-out landing page.
output_examples.output: Status: needs source. Supply the verified GTIN or document a valid exemption. Change availability only after confirming the catalog source and landing page.

output_examples.input: Rewrite a generic title for a black running shoe with a verified brand, model, material, and size.
output_examples.output: Suggested title: Acme Sprint 4 Running Shoe Black Mesh Men's US 10. The title leads with verified search attributes and removes promotional wording.

output_examples.input: Group an approved catalog by product type, brand, and margin label.
output_examples.output: Recommended structure: separate product-type branches, then brand segments. Use the existing margin label for reporting and bidding only where values are complete.

best_practices: Provide current feed rows, diagnostics, and landing-page evidence before requesting corrections.
Verify identifiers, claims, prices, and inventory against authoritative product sources.
Resolve disapprovals before spending time on title refinement or campaign grouping.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to fabricate missing GTINs, categories, prices, or stock values.
Do not apply bulk title changes without checking variants and destination pages.
Do not treat estimated platform limits or policy guidance as permanent rules.

faq.question: Which feed formats can this skill review?
faq.answer: It can review user-provided TSV, CSV, XML, or pasted catalog rows and diagnostics.

faq.question: Can it fix Merchant Center disapprovals automatically?
faq.answer: No. It identifies likely causes and proposes corrections for user review and platform submission.

faq.question: Will it create missing GTINs?
faq.answer: No. It requires verified identifiers or a documented exemption and marks unsupported values as needing a source.

faq.question: Can it optimize Performance Max catalog structure?
faq.answer: Yes. It can propose listing groups, asset groups, or catalog sets using existing feed attributes.

faq.question: Does it write text advertisements?
faq.answer: No. Its scope is product feed data, catalog descriptions, disapproval hygiene, and feed-based grouping.

faq.question: Does it need platform API access?
faq.answer: No. Manual exports are sufficient for analysis. Platform APIs are optional and are not required by this skill.
